proposal.description: run_counter is cleared on the low phase only after a pulse that was truncated, so the on-time of a pulse that ended under the ceiling carries over into the next pulse
proposal.reason: After a pwm_sync pulse shorter than max_on_counts, the next pulse starts counting from the previous width, so pwm_out is cut after max_on_counts - W + 1 clocks instead of max_on_counts + 1 (or not cut at all).

proposal.description: The saturation branch clamps run_counter to the present ceiling instead of holding it, so a ceiling lowered mid-pulse pulls the elapsed count down to it
proposal.reason: If max_on_counts drops below the running count during a high phase and then rises again within the same pulse (still at or below the true elapsed count), the mutant sees run_counter < max_on_counts and re-opens pulse_allowed, so pwm_out gives a second pulse in that cycle. The original keeps the envelope closed.

proposal.description: A zero on-time ceiling is treated as 'no limit', so pulses are passed through untruncated instead of being cut to one clock
proposal.reason: With max_on_counts = 0 and pwm_sync high for several clocks, the original pwm_out is high for one clock only (max_on_counts + 1). The mutant passes the whole pulse to pwm_out.
